Theorem
[asymptotic scalar curvature of positively curved steady solitons] Source: cao-zhu ↗ lem:cz-scalar-curvature-identities-for-steady-gradient-solitons 1. Theorem 4.4.2\group Cao–Zhu Ricci Solitons For a complete noncompact steady gradient Ricci soliton with bounded curvature and positive sectional curvature of dimension $n\ge 3$ where the scalar curvature assume its maximum at a point $O\in M$, the asymptotic scalar curvature ratio is infinite, i.e., \[ A=\limsup _{s\rightarrow +\infty }Rs^2=+\infty \] where s is the distance to the point $O$.
